prompt: I want to do a fast local debug build of Phoenix without setting up the full Neon storage stack, and later compare it against a production-like build. What are the two build modes, and what concretely differs between them (flags, block size, defines, output location)?

answer_points: Without Neon is the default (no flag); with Neon requires the `--enable-neon` configure flag
The `RELYT_WITH_NEON=true|false` environment variable controls which mode `neon/cicd/build.sh` builds
Block size differs: 8K with Neon vs 32K without Neon
With Neon defines the compiler macro `-DRELYT_WITH_NEON`; without Neon it is absent
Without-Neon output goes to /workspace/phoenix/work/app (cicd/build.sh) or neon/pg_install/v12 (RELYT_WITH_NEON=false full build); with-Neon output goes to neon/pg_install/v{12,14,15,16,17}
